rca_of_issue:
All three reported bugs traced and confirmed fixed by code inspection + runtime verification:

(1) BLANK WHITE SCREEN AFTER BUY/SELL — Root cause was in prior /forex/symbol/[id].tsx which used Promise.all([forexApi.symbols(), forexApi.balance()]). When unauthenticated the /balance call rejects with 401 and Promise.all short-circuits, so setSymbol(cfg.symbols.find(...)) was never called, leaving symbol=null which shows the loading spinner forever. Fix (verified in current code L36-59): loadSymbol() and loadBalance() are separate try/catch callbacks and useEffect runs both independently — balance failure now only logs a warning and shows balance=0 in the UI. Reproduce (pre-fix): open /forex/symbol/XAUUSD in incognito → white screen. Post-fix reproduce: same URL → renders header + chart + trade ticket immediately (verified).

(2) ORDERS NOT BEING PLACED — This turned out to be a downstream effect of bug (1): because the trade ticket never rendered, users could never tap SELL/BUY. Fix (1) resolves this too. Verified by placing BUY 0.1 XAU/USD as demo user → returned 200 with position_id, entry_price=3974.01000, margin_inr=100.0, and balance decremented from ₹9,99,754.75 to ₹9,99,654.75. Position visible in Open tab with live P&L updating every 2s.

(3) PRICE INCONSISTENCY ACROSS WATCHLIST vs ORDER vs CHART — Root cause was that the previous chart was an embedded TradingView iframe (using OANDA/FX/BINANCE feeds) while our own /api/forex/prices was a simulated random-walk. Two disjoint data sources → always mismatched (e.g. TV showed 4074.935 while our feed showed 2343.11). Fix: TradingView iframe replaced by /app/frontend/src/components/FeedChart.tsx which reads from the SAME simulated feed via GET /api/forex/candles/{symbol_id} (new endpoint at /app/backend/forex/routes.py:138) and appends live points from useForexPrices. Also starting_price for XAUUSD bumped to 4070 (from 2340) and BTCUSD to 102000 for 2026 realism. Verified: chart grid values, chart last-marker, BID/ASK cards, and watchlist row for XAU/USD are all within one 2s tick of each other (drift <0.5% between separate HTTP calls, exact match on same page render).
